chars.ADIL: ADIL: a young Moroccan man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a young Moroccan woman wearing a light pink hijab, a long olive-green coat and a small red handbag.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A cozy Casablanca cafe terrace with a small table, two coffee cups and a brown leather wallet. In the foreground SALMA, seated, sneakily pulls banknotes out of the open wallet with a guilty smirk, glancing sideways. A few meters behind her, ADIL peeks around a wall corner, holding up his phone to film her, his mouth wide open in comic shock.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a narrow cafe hallway near the restroom door, ADIL leans against the tiled wall, one mitten hand on his forehead, staring at his phone in disbelief, sweat drops flying, comic heartbroken expression.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close view of the cafe table: SALMA quickly slips folded banknotes into her red handbag, looking around innocently with a sweet fake smile, the empty wallet lying open on the table next to the coffee cups.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small cafe restroom with a mirror and sink, ADIL stands frozen in front of the mirror, arms crossed, frowning deeply and thinking hard, comic worried face.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A warm sunny memory on a Casablanca seaside corniche: SALMA lovingly hands ADIL an ice cream cone and smiles sweetly, ADIL looks at her with heart-eyed adoration, soft golden light.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Back at the cafe terrace table: ADIL sits down next to SALMA with a stiff, forced, awkward smile and tense shoulders, while SALMA happily sips her coffee as if nothing happened.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At night in a simple Moroccan bedroom lit by a lamp, ADIL sits on the edge of his bed, hunched over, rewatching a video on his glowing phone, eyebrows raised, analysing it seriously.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At night in the same bedroom, ADIL stands up holding his phone, with a big mischievous scheming grin and narrowed eyes, rubbing his chin like a cartoon villain with a brilliant plan, dramatic blue moonlight from the window.
